metadata.title: THE PROCUREMENT MACHINE - Primary Source Receipts Index
metadata.description: Every thesis claim mapped to verifiable primary source

source_grading_methodology.PRIMARY: Official government filings (SEC EDGAR, Congress.gov, Congressional Record, USAspending.gov, corporate registries, court dockets/PACER)
source_grading_methodology.SECONDARY: Major wire services with editorial oversight (Reuters, AP, AFP)
source_grading_methodology.PARTISAN: Outlets with clear ideological framing (Unlimited Hangout, E&E News)
source_grading_methodology.ANONYMOUS: Major outlets citing unnamed sources without document publication (WIRED/NYT/Guardian "sources say")
source_grading_methodology.COMPUTED_ON_AUTHOR_GRAPH: Metrics computed on author-constructed graphs/networks, not independent data
source_grading_methodology.NER_MATCH_ONLY: Named entity recognition match in OCR'd documents, no coreference resolution performed

source_grade_distribution.NOTE: Counts approximate; exact tally requires parsing all receipt texts

TC-5.qualification: Betweenness centrality 0.42 computed on AUTHOR-CONSTRUCTED 22-node graph (9 PMs, 4 Boards, 9 Operators). Directionally plausible but not independently verifiable.

TC-6.claim: Epstein archive (29,525 entities) contains 11/11 falsifier entities
TC-6.falsifier: Epstein archive doesn't contain named entities OR entity resolution fails

receipts.text: R-EPSTEIN-ARCHIVE-001: epstein-docs.github.io dedupe.json (29,525 entities total: 11,299 people, 5,590 orgs, 2,956 locations)
R-EPSTEIN-ENTITY-001: Wexner, Acosta, Clinton, Trump, Dershowitz, Bannon, Carlson, Maxwell, Barr — NAME STRING MATCHES FOUND in 11,299 people

R-EPSTEIN-ENTITY-002: Griffin, Vance Jr., Netanyahu, Bancor, TokenUnion, Palantir, SpaceX, Founders Fund, Kalshi, Polymarket, Augur, In-Q-Tel, NSCAI, Bilderberg — NO MATCHES in 11,299 people / 5,590 orgs

R-EPSTEIN-QUALIFICATION: '11/11 verified' = 9/11 name string matches (Wexner, Acosta, Clinton, Trump, Dershowitz, Bannon, Carlson, Maxwell, Barr). 2/11 (Griffin, Vance) NO MATCH. 8/11 key orgs NO MATCH. NO COREFERENCE RESOLUTION performed. Grade: NER_MATCH_ONLY

TC-6.qualification: Epstein archive contains 11,299 deduplicated people entities. 9/11 falsifier individuals have NAME STRING MATCHES (Wexner, Acosta, Clinton, Trump, Dershowitz, Bannon, Carlson, Maxwell, Barr). 2/11 (Griffin, Vance Jr.) have NO MATCHES. 8/11 key organizations (Bancor, TokenUnion, Palantir, SpaceX, Founders Fund, Kalshi, Polymarket, Augur, In-Q-Tel, NSCAI, Bilderberg) have NO MATCHES. NO COREFERENCE RESOLUTION performed — 'Mike Griffin' in archive ≠ 'Michael Griffin NASA Admin' (common name). Grade: NER_MATCH_ONLY. Claim should read: '9/11 falsifier individuals have name string matches in Epstein archive; 2 individuals and all key organizations absent; no entity resolution performed.'

R-EENEWS-028: E&E News 2024 'Musk lobbies to KEEP ZEV credits'

TC-9.qualification: Tesla 10-K FY2020: ZEV credits $1.58B vs net income $721M = 219% of net income. FY2021: $1.47B, FY2022: $1.78B, FY2023: $1.79B. Source: PRIMARY (SEC EDGAR 10-K filings). E&E News 2024 quote graded PARTISAN but corroborated by PRIMARY filings.

TC-10.falsifier: Contract value not $1.8B OR not classified OR not 2021 OR not 5 sources
TC-10.qualification: Reuters 2024-03-16 cites '5 sources' for $1.8B NRO Starshield contract. Source grade: SECONDARY (Reuters wire service). Contract classified — no public docket. Independent confirmation impossible. Acceptable as SECONDARY but not PRIMARY.
